fusions.name: Downdraft
fusions.desc: Sends a downdraft across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 wind damage, knocks everything in it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Circling Wait
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Stoops on a target up to 8 tiles away and deals 20 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Easy Descent
fusions.desc: Moves you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Soft Landing
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
